title: AMD’s $566 Million SpaceX Stake Raises a Bigger Question Than AI Chip Orders
excerpt: SpaceX just told the world it will build its AI infrastructure exclusively on Nvidia chips, yet AMD quietly poured more than half a billion dollars into Elon...

Every August, Wall Street gets a fresh batch of 13F filings -- and a glimpse into what some of the world's biggest investors were buying three months earlier. This year's filings offered something more unusual: a look at who owned SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) after its blockbuster June IPO.

The list included some obvious names. Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOG) had a massive position built over years. Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) held a stake tied to its AI ambitions. Then there was Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD), which revealed roughly 3.3 million SpaceX shares worth more than $565 million.

That would be interesting enough on its own, but there's a wrinkle: Just two months before SpaceX's IPO, Elon Musk said the company's AI infrastructure would be built exclusively on Nvidia chips.

So why is AMD putting more than half a billion dollars into a company that appears to have chosen its biggest rival?

The Filing, in Plain Numbers

SpaceX priced 555.6 million Class A shares at $135 apiece in its June 12 IPO, raising roughly $75 billion. The offering also brought previously private holdings into the spotlight through mandatory 13F filings.

每年八月，华尔街都会收到一批新的 13F 文件，并了解一些全球最大的投资者三个月前购买的股票。 今年的文件提供了一些更不寻常的东西：看看 SpaceX（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）在 6 月份轰动一时的 IPO 后谁拥有它。

该列表包括一些显而易见的名字。 Alphabet（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）多年来建立了巨大的地位。 英伟达（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）持有与其人工智能野心相关的股份。 然后是 Advanced Micro Devices（纳斯达克股票代码：AMD），该公司披露了大约 330 万股 SpaceX 股票，价值超过 5.65 亿美元。

这本身就很有趣，但有一个问题：就在 SpaceX 首次公开募股前两个月，埃隆·马斯克表示，该公司的人工智能基础设施将完全基于 Nvidia 芯片构建。

那么，AMD 为什么要向一家似乎选择了其最大竞争对手的公司投入超过 5 亿美元呢？

备案，以简单的数字

SpaceX 在 6 月 12 日的 IPO 中以每股 135 美元的价格发行了 5.556 亿 A 类股票，筹集了约 750 亿美元。 此次发行还通过强制性 13F 备案使之前的私人持股成为人们关注的焦点。
